meta.title: Expenvia — Every branch. Every expense. One clear view.
meta.description: Multi-branch expense, vendor invoice and approval management for growing organizations.

landing.heroTitle: Every Branch. Every Expense. One Clear View.
landing.heroBody: Bring branch expenses, vendor invoices, approvals, and financial visibility together in one intelligent workspace.
landing.workflowTitle: One workflow from receipt to reconciliation
landing.workflowBody: Employees record expenses, vendors invoice the branches they serve, and administrators approve, pay and report — each seeing only what their role allows.
landing.step1Body: Employees record their own branch expenses with receipts.
landing.step2Body: Approved vendors bill only their assigned branches.
landing.step3Body: Super Admins review financial submissions with full context and history.
landing.step4Body: Payments, outstanding balances and branch analytics remain connected.

journey.footnote: One connected record. Clear responsibility at every step.

landing.capTitle: Built for organizations that run on many branches
landing.cap1Body: Create branches as you grow. Every expense and invoice keeps its branch — even after people move.
landing.cap2Body: A guided invoice builder with exact decimal math, sequential numbering and print-ready PDFs.
landing.cap3Body: Draft, submit, review, approve or request revisions — every transition recorded.
landing.cap4Body: Record full or partial payments against approved invoices. Overpayment is blocked.
landing.cap5Body: Link an employee expense to the vendor invoice it duplicates so totals stay honest.
landing.cap6Body: Trends by month, branch and category — computed from approved records only.
landing.branchesBody: Head office sees the whole network. Each employee sees their own submissions. Each vendor sees only their own invoices.
landing.sec1: Role-based access enforced on the server for every request
landing.sec2: Append-only audit trail of approvals, payments and access
landing.sec3: Argon2id password hashing and revocable sessions
landing.sec4: Private receipt and invoice storage with authorized downloads
landing.langBody: A complete right-to-left Urdu interface with proper Nastaliq typography — not a mirrored afterthought.
landing.closingBody: Request an account and an administrator will review your access.
